title: A pharmacist maintains an NABP e-profile number
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(20), a pharmacist shall maintain an NABP e-profile number. Under 247 CMR 2.00, NABP means the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy.
exam_relevance: Tests the pharmacist's duty to maintain an NABP e-profile number.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
authority.section: 247 CMR 2.00, definitions of NABP and NABP Number

common_confusions: 247 CMR 2.00 separately defines the term NABP Number as a unique seven digit number issued by the National Council for Prescription Drug Programs; 247 CMR 9.01(20) uses the words NABP e-profile number.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publications of 247 CMR 9.00 (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024) and 247 CMR 2.00 (PDF) on mass.gov.
